scope: Proposition 3.8 of the manuscript “Donovan's Conjecture over Algebraically Closed Fields” (preprints/Donovans-Conjecture-over-Algebraic-Closures-of-Prime-Fields-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 203 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 80d721e72d29a9bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The modules Px,ϕ are projective. Let ˆ︁ Ax be the ordinary linear characters of Ax, with ξ ↦→ ξ̄ their modular reductions, and set Ψx,ϕ = (−1)ℓ(x) ∑ ξ∈ ˆ︁ Ax ξ̄=ϕ RG Tx (ξ). (3.9) If nx,ϕ;y,η are the multiplicities in the specified standard flag, the ordinary lift character of Px,ϕ is χPx,ϕ = ∑ y,η nx,ϕ;y,ηΨy,η, ∑ y,η nx,ϕ;y,η ≤ L. (3.10) These projective characters and the Ψx,ϕ have the same linear span in characteristic zero, and that span contains the regular character of Γ.
